intro.what: Ingliz tilida otlarni birlikdan ko'plikka o'tkazish uchun -s, -es, -ies qo'shimchalari ishlatiladi. Ba'zi otlar esa noto'g'ri shaklga ega bo'lib, butunlay o'zgaradi.
when: Bitta narsa yoki shaxs haqida gapirganda birlik ot ishlatiladi.
Ikki va undan ortiq narsalar haqida gapirganda ko'plik ot ishlatiladi.
-y harfi bilan tugagan va oldi undosh bo'lgan so'zlarda -ies qo'shiladi.
Ba'zi inson va tana a'zolari noto'g'ri ko'plik shaklini oladi.

rules.title: -y to -ies qoidasi
rules.text: Agar ot undosh harf va y harfi bilan tugasa, y tushib qoladi va -ies qo'shiladi.

rules.title: -es qo'shimchasi
rules.text: Agar ot s, ss, sh, ch, x, o harflari bilan tugasa, -es qo'shiladi.

rules.title: Noto'g'ri ko'plik otlar
rules.text: Bu otlar -s yoki -es olmaydi, ularning ko'plik shakli boshqacha yoziladi.

mistakes.why: Undosh + y harfi bilan tugagan so'zlarda y tushib, -ies yoziladi.
Man so'zi noto'g'ri ot bo'lib, ko'plikda men bo'ladi.
Child so'zining ko'plik shakli children hisoblanadi.

test.q: This is a bus. Those are two ______.
test.explain: -s, -ss, -sh, -ch, -x, -o bilan tugagan otlarga -es qo'shiladi.

test.q: She has a cat. I have two ______.
test.explain: Oddiy otlarga ko'plik yasash uchun -s qo'shiladi.

test.q: This is a dog. Those are three ______.
test.explain: Oddiy otlarga -s qo'shish orqali ko'plik yasaladi.

test.q: This is an apple. These are five ______.
test.explain: Apple so'zining ko'plik shakli apples.

test.q: That is a house. These are four ______.
test.explain: House so'ziga -s qo'shilib houses bo'ladi.

test.q: This is a car. Those are two ______.
test.explain: Car so'zi ko'plikda cars bo'ladi.

test.q: This is a country. Uzbekistan and England are ______.
test.explain: Undosh + y bilan tugagan country so'zi countries bo'lib o'zgaradi.

test.q: Tashkent is a big city. Samarkand and Bukhara are ______.
test.explain: City so'zi -ies qoidasi bo'yicha cities bo'ladi.

test.q: There is a man in the car. There are two ______ in the bus.
test.explain: Man so'zining noto'g'ri ko'plik shakli men.

test.q: She is a woman. They are two ______.
test.explain: Woman so'zi noto'g'ri ot bo'lib, women bo'ladi.

test.q: He is a child. They are three ______.
test.explain: Child so'zining ko'plik shakli children.

test.q: One person is here. Many ______ are in the street.
test.explain: Person so'zining ko'plik shakli people.

test.q: This is a foot. These are two ______.
test.explain: Foot so'zining noto'g'ri ko'plik shakli feet.

test.q: This is a tooth. These are white ______.
test.explain: Tooth so'zining noto'g'ri ko'plik shakli teeth.

test.q: This is a sandwich. Those are two ______.
test.explain: -ch bilan tugagan so'zlarga -es qo'shiladi.

test.q: This is a box. Those are four ______.
test.explain: -x bilan tugagan box so'zi boxes bo'ladi.

test.q: That is a book. These are my ______.
test.explain: Book so'ziga -s qo'shib books yasaladi.

test.q: This is a bag. Those are your ______.
test.explain: Bag so'zining ko'plik shakli bags.

test.q: This is a baby. Those are cute ______.
test.explain: Baby so'zi undosh + y bilan tugagani uchun babies bo'ladi.

test.q: This is a family. We have two ______.
test.explain: Family so'zi -ies qoidasiga ko'ra families bo'ladi.
